## Authoritative work packet register

**Single source of truth:** This main ledger owns ALL work packet definitions, priority, dependencies, owners and progress, including feature work, mission content, issue corrections, CI/tooling, documentation, assets and release work. A task is assigned or changed here before its handoff is sent. Other documents may explain implementation or workflow and GitHub may hold findings, reviews and results, but they must reference the ledger packet ID and must not maintain a competing assignment, priority or completion register. Older queues and assignment prose below are retained history where superseded by this register. The [developer/reviewer workflow](DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW.md) governs how work proceeds; [workflow metrics](WORKFLOW-METRICS.md) are measurement extracts, never a second work plan.

**Ownership and update rule:** Root owns priorities and resolves scope conflicts; G1 owns implementation, isolated-unit authoring, canonical composition and source pushes; G2 owns independent code/result review. These are the default owners of every packet below unless its row explicitly records an exception. Candidate source boundaries below are scope limits, not concurrent checkout reservations. Before starting a packet, record the actual owner, branch/base and precise files/symbols here; preserve another worker's edits. A GitHub finding receives a stable child of its affected packet, such as `G12.P01.I123`, with the actual issue link, bounded cause/fix and owner here before assignment. An issue comment cannot expand a packet's scope.

**Progress fields:** Keep the four functional statuses below, and separately record source-written SHA, pushed SHA/branch, review SHA/result/issue links, GitHub isolated-unit head/run/selection/result, source composition, usable build and release. A pending, skipped or startup-failed unit run is not PASS. A clean code review is not a unit result. Pushed source is not a playable build; a first slice is not a completed campaign. Update these fields at assignment, source push and material review/result/delivery changes, not at every poll. Existing evidence and limitations in the detailed rows remain attached to their original IDs; never relabel historical failures or UNKNOWN results.

**Selection order:** Ready actionable MBA findings take precedence at each pushed-packet boundary. Otherwise take ready M01 work first, then the earliest ready milestone/child in this register, with Root's recorded priority changes taking precedence. Dependencies mean the required source behavior exists, not that the developer must await review, GitHub, a new build or an acknowledgement. Skip an actual missing source/input dependency, record it here and take the next ready packet. No packet below authorizes integration testing, a native journey, GUI/system/performance testing, broad `make ci`, a new research campaign or a Sonar scan off committed `main`.

The exact accepted stage keys, branches, objective predicates, quantities/timers/rewards, character/world IDs and asset references must be bound in the child row before implementation; if unavailable, record the input gap and select another ready item. Do not invent missing authoring or use predecessor stories. In particular C05's newest physical disaster requirements supersede older FR-052, and C39 is the accepted nine-stage `l337.guiding-light`, not the older Crimbo prototype.

**Per-child delivered behavior:** Its one or two named stages become playable using actual native producers/receivers, the accepted options and each legitimate success/failure/cancel consequence. Each child owns its exact campaign pack/adapter stage functions, stage-specific provider declarations, current codec fields and visible gallery/dialogue/art bindings, with only minimal default-library/current-ID/clue registration. Tests isolate the stage reducer/predicates, native receipt policy and codec, including duplicate/forged events and failed publication; no whole-game journey. The first child also supplies real offer/accept/decline prerequisites; the final child includes every accepted terminal/epilogue, legitimate ending, once-only reward/clue and final gallery state. Intermediate children must stop honestly at undelivered stages. No whole-campaign completion until every authored stage, branch and outcome is implemented; a branch that skips an ordinal retains the accepted graph, not a new forced linear order.

**Dependencies/ownership:** All campaign children default to G1 implementation/G2 review/Root prioritisation. First child requires validated current pack support plus the native capability for its actual opening, as listed. Later children depend on the preceding child's state/pack interfaces and the exact producer they consume, not on its review or player taking every earlier branch. #### Mission packet sizing refinement - 22 October 2026

**Authority and scope:** This subsection refines only outstanding compound work in the register above; it is part of the main ledger, not another queue. Parent IDs, milestone priority, accepted narrative, stage graph, rewards, branches, owners and all prior source/review/unit/build evidence remain intact. Unimplemented two-stage groups become containers for the leaves below. A container is not independently assigned as an additional whole-mission implementation. Existing source and active assignments take precedence over a generic not-started description elsewhere in the ledger. No previously delivered slice is reopened.

**Owners and state:** Unless a row explicitly retains a live assignment, every new leaf is not started, with G1 implementing, G2 reviewing source and existing hosted isolated-unit results, and Root prioritising. Dependencies below are actual native capabilities or prerequisite authored receipts, never review/ACK/service-recovery waiting states. The original parent still owns every unsatisfied requirement. Update the owning leaf here when assigned/pushed; record source/review/unit/build states separately and keep previous evidence attached. This refinement adds no new execution requirement or integration test.

**Bounded source contract:** One leaf implements one accepted stage transition or one explicitly named native producer/branch. It owns that exact stage in its current-ID pack, its campaign-specific policy/codec and minimal observation/receiving caller, plus the affected board/Gallery/dialogue/art projection and directly affected component units. Reuse existing admission, custody, quote, publication, save-envelope and clue machinery; do not replace the engine, rewrite unrelated stages or activate all hulls. If the accepted stage needs a genuinely absent source, its named source prerequisite is a separate native capability, not a reason to substitute a marker, generic actor, UI flag or accounting-only gate. Record the precise changed files/symbols at assignment without adding an approval wait.

**Acceptance common to every leaf:** The player can perform its named action with the real accepted target/owner/world, and the actual native receipt advances only that stage. Refusal/Esc/forged/duplicate evidence cannot change custody or grant progress; interrupted work and current-format codec state preserve the accepted rules. Isolated policy/codec cases cover its changed behavior, including the necessary native authority join. Visible Gallery progress, stage art and help describe only delivered actions; future stages remain honestly unavailable. An atomic handoff includes its item removals/additions and receipt together. Final payment, clue, entitlement and terminal receipt remain one atomic publication, never separate reward-only commits.

**Accepted input binding:** The maintained input set is [original-missions](</Users/sclarke/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/13/01a136c8-628e-7112-a1af-e1e3e59b1859/original-missions>). Each row below binds the exact TOML stage key rather than an inferred stage number. Keep its current objective, targets, locationKey, itemEffects, choices/branchVariants, recovery rules, timer rules, receipt and artwork. Explicit later authoring decisions already recorded in this ledger, including C08 funding/physical bindings and C05 disaster constraints, retain precedence. Missing numeric budgets, physical anchors or resource rules are flagged as inputs, not invented or made into a research campaign.

| Native acceptance class | Immediate source dependency and concise completion criterion |
| --- | --- |
| D - docked contact | Actual owning station/contact and prerequisite receipts. Accept/receive/audit exactly the authored transaction; a dialog click alone cannot substitute for required custody or observations. Commission leaves include real eligibility/accept/decline, with no future success credit. |
| S - observed scan | Actual admitted named targets plus the existing measured observation policy. Require the authored fit/consent/dwell/geometry and every declared target once; borrowed observations, unfinished dwell and target replacement cannot forge completion. Reuse C01/G10 primitives; each new target still needs its own real provider binding. |
| C / R - recovery / delivery | Finite original item, actual recovery aperture or authorised source desk, fit/capacity and custody; R also needs the actual receiver. Conserve the same item, reject duplicate/lost/foreign handoffs and publish custody plus receipt atomically. Existing K06 and G/W custody implementations are reusable. |
| W - physical work | Actual stage-specific components, owning tool and native resource/control state. Every required work proof must follow a real change/measurement; persist independent completed targets and refuse an unperformed operation. A bare resource_node_secured or mission_action_confirmed string is not authority. |
| E - escort receiving | Same registered actor, original living crew/cargo, real route/fuel/docking and destination receiving. Reuse C08 native transit/receiving where sufficient, but bind the new actual source. Cull/disappearance/marker proximity cannot count as arrival; replacement remains finite and follows only accepted recovery rules. |
| B - branch choice | Actual eligible contact and named choice IDs. Esc/preview commits nothing; persist the selected branch once, with truthful unavailable branches until their source is delivered. Choice alone never supplies later physical/receiving proof. |
| X - disabled objective | Exact marked unmanned component and native weapon/control-loss cause. Require every named disabled/power-isolated target; an unrelated kill, ordinary despawn or a borrowed EMP flag cannot supply evidence. Preserve real law and causal attribution. |
| H - hazard resolution | Actual armed deadline, debris/station/population state and owning mitigation/evacuation receipts. Resolve the legitimate physical outcome once, preserving conservation and elapsed clock. Reuse collision source; that source alone does not supply a disaster outcome. |
| F - terminal | Actual final receiver plus every accepted prerequisite and selected-branch proof. In one durable transaction pay the authored amount/one permitted bonus, record legitimate outcome/gossip, grant its unique clue/entitlement and terminal receipt; refuse duplicates and roll back failed publication. |

**Dependencies between stages:** A leaf depends on the accepted graph predecessor and the native class above; it does not force players through an unchosen alternative. A branch-specific leaf depends on the persisted choice and its own source, not on the player completing another branch. Both advertised branches remain implementation obligations before the parent is complete. Existing branch/reward/asset requirements outside the numbered stage array remain under the same parent.

## Status and delivery rules

Use exactly these four primary statuses for functional work:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| completed | The named capability is usable with observable evidence on an exact identified deliverable. Record its build/source and limits. Authored assets, fixtures, unit passes or unmerged source alone never qualify. |
| pending integration | The bounded implementation has owner-focused unit tests PASS and a completed clean code review for bugs, performance and style, with exact frozen source/evidence. It awaits G1 composition. UNRUN/unreviewed packets do not qualify. |
| in development | Implementation or owner validation/review is underway, or usable acceptance is incomplete/blocked. A frozen patch with UNRUN tests/uncompleted review remains here, with the actual gap recorded. |
| not started | No implementation of this exact approved functional target is established. Designs/assets may be ready; shared engine code does not make its campaign playable. |

Delivery is a separate field: prepared branch; integrated source; verified local app; merged main; published release; published Homebrew. Record multiple locations when needed. Never infer progression between them. No L337 milestone is currently completed. Historical completed features may be reused, but predecessor completion is not current L337 acceptance. Unknown evidence is unknown, not an automatic pass or proof that every implementation is absent.

## Complete current mission inventory

Expected playable source inventory: **39 campaigns + 15 general generated families + 6 Wayfarer generated services + 4 tutorials = 64 distinct first-success clue sources**. Q01 is the additional gated finale and does not award a 65th prerequisite clue. All64 source IDs match the accepted reconciliation exactly. C/G/W/T numbers below are ledger keys, not runtime replacements for the full IDs.

**Current content status basis:** the source contains a64-entry clue registry and reusable engine/native capabilities. Bundled schema2 packs are `project.generated-couriers` and `project.crimbo`; built-in predecessor campaigns are separate. None of those proves the exact approved `l337.*` campaign/family is implemented. G03 is in development through its assigned exact-profile adapter and W01 through its specific integrity support; remaining exact current targets stay not started unless an owner supplies concrete current-ID adaptation. Neither is claimed playable. This is not a claim that shared engine work or authored TOML/art is missing. Prepared worker content outside this source snapshot is an explicit unknown U01.

For every row, delivery location is **prepared design assets** in the accepted content bundle; source-native foundations are reusable but not completed row delivery. A completed row requires its advertised prerequisites, exact stage-specific actions, legitimate outcomes and once-only settlement/clue. Decline/cancel/failure cannot award success; losses and current-format progress remain durable. Focused unit tests accompany each adaptation; broad combined playthroughs are batched after several content deliveries.

### G03 authored quote and optional time rules

The approved `original-missions/original-families.md` Bonded freight passage section explicitly states **480 CR base +95 CR per full reachable route leg +80 CR per declared hazard tier**. With quoted full reachable leg count L and declared hazard tier H, reward is `480 + 95*L + 80*H` CR, or `4800 + 950*L + 800*H` native tenths. The75CR bond is separate: existing successful settlement returns the quoted reward plus750 native deposit once. The hazard premium is per declared tier, not always-on, per cargo tonne or per leg. Use checked arithmetic and existing cash/reward-plus-deposit bounds; no legacy schedule/multiplier.

The G03 JSON declares `deadlineSeconds=0` and `scanSeconds=0`: **the base family is untimed**. The shared authored contract requires preview of any explicit clock before Confirm, no unquoted deadline, pause-frozen armed flight simulation and current-format remainder preservation. A future timed variant must supply its positive finite duration through declared immutable quote data and current clock bounds; absent/0 is no deadline, never deadline-now or a difficulty/distance-generated legacy duration. Changing screens/loading cannot reroll the quoted terms or reset accepted time.

Genuine source ambiguities remain explicit: no hazard-tier taxonomy/route-government mapping, rule choosing shortest versus another valid quoted route, or positive optional duration is authored. For the current01 task, Root confirms selected full path.count-1 asL, immutable declaredH and optional timingdisabled. Keep other future route/hazard/duration variants validated data inputs with provenance; do not invent tuning or an undeclared hazard premium. `ENGINE-CONTRACT.md` specifies actual pickup as the start for Wayfarer budgets, while generic G03 says armed flight budget without a separate arming receipt. A future timed G03 variant must explicitly declare its native arming receipt; actual pickup (acceptance only if the same transaction) is the Wayfarer precedent, not a separately specified G03 rule.
